content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for KAU Assistant Professor (Horticulture) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Kerala Agricultural University (KAU) for filling up faculty positions on a contract basis in Vellanikkara, Kerala.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment notification?
faq.answer: The notification has been released for the position of Assistant Professor (Horticulture) under advertisement number No.Veg/05/2017.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for Assistant Professor (Horticulture)?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Assistant Professor (Horticulture) post under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection process for KAU Assistant Professor recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates for the Assistant Professor (Horticulture) position will be carried out entirely through a Walk-in-interview process.

faq.question: Q5. When is the walk-in-interview scheduled to take place?
faq.answer: The walk-in-interview for the Assistant Professor (Horticulture) post is officially scheduled to be held on 15 October 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required educational qualification for the post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's Degree in Horticulture with NET recognized by KAU. In the absence of NET, PhD or Master's degree holders will also be considered.

faq.question: Q7. What is the upper age limit to apply for this job?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 50 years. Age relaxations will be applicable according to existing government rules for eligible categories.

faq.question: Q8. What is the monthly salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates appointed as Assistant Professor (Horticulture) on a contract basis will receive a consolidated pay of ₹44100/- per month.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required to attend the interview?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for attending the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry original and self-attested photocopies of certificates proving age, educational qualifications, NET/PhD status, category, and experience for verification.
